jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
🚀 We're Hiring: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

📍 Location: JBT Marel Lichtenvoorde

🕒 Employment Type: Full-Time, Hybrid (3-4 days a week at the office)

💼 Department: MEAT – Primary EMEA

💥 Lead the Future of Work at JBT Marel

If you like to do what you love, you’ll enjoy being a part of our software team at JBT Marel.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer
to join our Engineering team working on innovative software products for the Food Industry. In the role of a Senior Software Engineer, you will have a key role in the development of our software that supports JBT Marel‘s vision of transforming the way food is processed globally.

Within our team we encourage everyone to come forward with interesting ideas and challenge our way of thinking, so we can make the good things happen. If you’re interested in best practices and learning new technics/tools – JBT Marel is the place to be.

🔍 About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of software modules that support JBT-Marel’s vision. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including machine engineering and software platform development teams, to deliver robust and scalable solutions for industrial food processing machines.

🧠 What You’ll Do

Lead design, implementation, and testing of innovative software modules and features.
Optimize existing software solutions and design next gen software solutions for the food processing industry
Analyze requirements and write design specifications for software modules and software features
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team collaboration.
Collaborate with multiple internal teams to ensure system architecture is implemented and tested.
Occasionally support product releases and training on customer sites.
Train and mentor Software Engineers and Associate Software Engineers
Contribute to team collaboration and build team spirit
Work in an Agile Scrum environment focused on collaboration, speed, and customer value

🛠️ What You Bring

We encourage each of our 12,000+ employees to bring their unique self to work and aim to make everyone feel recognized, valued and free to explore their potential. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture and welcome new colleagues from all walks of life. You will recognize in yourself that you:

Bachelor’s or Master‘s degree in computer science or similar, or comparable work experience and knowledge
Experience with .NET and Docker.
Experience with Azure DevOps and Git.
Experience in designing, developing, and implementing large software solutions with object-oriented programming languages, in combination with .NET software development.
Strong knowledge of SQL and good understanding of database operations
Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of co-workers, stakeholders, and customers.
Fluent in English (written and verbal).
Willingness to travel occasionally.

🌟
Nice to Have

Background in industrial automation or machine control.
Understanding of reliability requirements in the food industry.
Experience with and comfort working in multi-cultural, multi-discipline organization is an advantage.
Familiar with Agile software development frameworks and database operations
Basic knowledge of Linux and familiarity with PLCs.

🏬 Why Join Us?

There’s Nothing Like The Feeling You Get When You Do Something Worthwhile For a Living. That Said, Coming Home From Work Knowing You Made a Difference Is Just One Of The Great Things You Can Experience At JBT Marel. You Can Expect

Freedom to form your role and define your added value to the organization
Freedom to take initiative and make a real impact in a growing global business
An environment of trust and respect with space to explore and fail
A collaborative, inclusive team culture with international cooperation
Continuous learning through our advanced learning platform, with unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning and Busuu language learning
All the tools you need to succeed: laptop, iPhone, and a fully equipped home office
Excellent work life balance, including 42 vacation days, flexible working hours, and hybrid working options
A strong pension plan and collective health insurance options
An environment built on trust and respect, with room to explore, learn, and even fail
To get a career instead of a job. We have many opportunities for internal growth; and we encourage it!

📩 How To Apply

We’re excited to learn how you can contribute to our mission of smarter, safer food inspection. Apply now and join a team transforming the future of food processing.

📧 Questions? Contact: Maarten Krepel – maarten.krepel@jbtmarel.com

🌐 Learn more at: jbtmarel.com

🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn

Connect with Talent Acquisition Specialist: www.linkedin.com/in/maartenkrepel

JBT Marel is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply.

Join us — and be the driving force behind smarter, leaner food production.

möglich.

Bei uns erwartet dich ein internationales und multikulturelles Team

jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview 

We are building a cutting-edge Platform that will transform the way our customers identify, protect and govern their data. This will revolutionize how customers secure their data by placing identity at the core — providing unparalleled visibility and control.

We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to design, build, and operate the services powering our enterprise SaaS security platform. You will work across a microservices architecture spanning ASP.NET Core APIs, Azure Functions, SQL Server, and Azure CosmosDB — shipping capabilities that serve Fortune 500 customers in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments at high scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role where strong technical execution, distributed-systems fluency, and a security-first mindset are essential. You will independently own features and services end-to-end, collaborating closely with product, architecture, and fellow engineers to deliver scalable, multi-tenant solutions that meet enterprise and regulatory standards.

This is a hybrid role with visits to our Kraków office.

Key Responsibilities 

Backend Service Development

Design and implement backend features end-to-end: from ASP.NET Core REST APIs and Azure Functions through to SQL Server and CosmosDB data layers.
Develop and extend .NET services within a microservices architecture composed of independently scalable, per-service function hosts.
Write and maintain Azure Functions for asynchronous processing workloads.
Build resilient, idempotent message-driven workflows using Azure Service Bus.

Data & Cloud Engineering

Work with SQL Server and Azure CosmosDB to implement performant, secure data access patterns at scale.
Own data access patterns that respect multi-tenant isolation boundaries and comply with security and privacy requirements, including RLS policy management.
Leverage Azure platform services including Service Bus, Blob Storage, Azure App Configuration, Application Insights, and Entra ID integration.

Quality & DevOps

Write comprehensive backend tests: xUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions for unit and integration coverage.
Participate in CI/CD pipeline maintenance using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.
Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and containerized local development (Docker Compose, Azurite).
Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and technical debt across services.

Collaboration & Growth

Independently break down and deliver complex backend work, owning full project lifecycles from design through production.
Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design decisions; enforce best practices across the codebase.
Partner with product managers and frontend/full-stack engineers to define clean, well-documented API contracts.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, code review, and knowledge sharing.
Champion the use of AI-driven approaches within the development process to enhance quality, speed, and innovation.

Qualifications  

6-8 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend/distributed-systems focus.
Strong proficiency in **C# / .NET 8/10** (ASP.NET Core APIs, Azure Functions, isolated worker model).
Hands-on experience with **SQL Server** (T-SQL, Entity Framework Core, relational modelling, Row-Level Security) and at least one NoSQL database (CosmosDB preferred).
Experience building and operating **Azure-hosted** services (Functions, Service Bus, Blob Storage, App Configuration, Application Insights).
Solid understanding of **authentication and authorization** patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Auth0 or similar identity providers).
Experience with **multi-tenant SaaS** architectures and the data isolation patterns they require.
Comfortable designing and debugging **asynchronous, message-driven systems** (queues, event-driven processing, idempotency, retries).
Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines** (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Familiarity with **Docker and Kubernetes**.
Strong testing discipline (unit, integration) using xUnit/Moq/FluentAssertions or equivalent.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.

Preferred Qualifications 

Exposure to enterprise security domains (identity security, data security posture management, compliance).
Experience with **Azure CosmosDB** (SQL API and/or Gremlin graph API), including partitioning and throughput tuning.
Experience designing service boundaries in a **microservices architecture** with independent scaling and deployment.
Experience building compliance-ready products (e.g., SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA, ISO 27001).

Temasek is a global investment company headquartered in Singapore, with a net portfolio value of S$518 billion (US$401b, €350b, £304b, RMB2.77t) as at 31 March 2026. Our Purpose “ So Every Generation Prospers ” guides us to make a difference for today’s and future generations. For more information on Temasek, please visit www.temasek.com.sg    
For Temasek Review 2026, please visit www.temasekreview.com.sg
For Sustainability Report 2026, please visit www.temasek.com.sg/SR2026

Introduction
Agentic AI engineering is a frontier discipline that requires both deep AI system knowledge and the full-stack engineering rigour to ship production-grade systems that operate reliably at enterprise scale. Building an agent that works in a notebook is table stakes; building one that handles edge cases gracefully, integrates securely with enterprise systems, and can be monitored and maintained by a team is the real engineering challenge. 

The Full Stack Agentic AI Engineer at Temasek is a hands-on builder responsible for designing, building, and operating AI-powered products and agent workflows across Temasek's investment and operations functions. You will work end-to-end — from LLM integration and agent orchestration through to front-end interfaces, API integrations, and production monitoring — with a relentless focus on reliability, observability, and user experience. You will be building systems that investment professionals and operations teams depend on for real decisions, not demos.

Responsibilities
Agentic AI system engineering

Design and implement multi-step agentic AI workflows: agent orchestration (single-agent and multi-agent coordination), tool-calling architectures, memory and state management, and planning and reasoning loops using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom orchestration.
Build production-grade RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines: document ingestion and chunking strategies, embedding generation and management, vector store integration (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or equivalent), semantic search, and hybrid retrieval architectures.
Implement robust tool and API integration layers that allow AI agents to safely interact with enterprise systems — including investment data platforms, portfolio management systems, market data APIs, and internal knowledge bases — with appropriate access controls, rate limiting, and error handling.
Engineer agent prompting and context management systems: system prompt architecture, dynamic context construction, prompt versioning, and evaluation-driven prompt optimisation using automated and human evaluation frameworks.
Contribute to the design and extension of Temasek's MCP (Model Context Protocol) server ecosystem — building new tool connectors and extending the platform's tool library with reusable, well-documented integrations.

Full-stack product engineering

Build the full application stack for AI products: React or equivalent front-end interfaces designed for professional user workflows; Python or Node.js back-end services; RESTful and streaming API layers; and enterprise integration middleware.
Design and implement real-time AI interaction patterns: streaming LLM responses, progressive disclosure of agent reasoning steps, asynchronous long-running agent task management, and WebSocket-based live update interfaces.
Own API design and documentation for AI product services — ensuring clean contracts, versioning discipline, and integration documentation that enables downstream consumers (other internal systems, citizen developer tools) to build reliably on your services.
Collaborate with data engineers to design the data access layer for AI products: query optimisation for AI-readable data, structured data extraction from unstructured sources, and data pipeline integrations that keep AI product knowledge bases current.

Production engineering and reliability

Instrument all AI systems with comprehensive observability: structured logging of agent actions, LLM call tracing (latency, token usage, model version), error rate monitoring, and alerting calibrated to the failure modes specific to agentic systems.
Design for graceful degradation: ensure AI systems fail safely, fall back to human escalation paths when uncertain, and communicate their limitations clearly to users — critical in a financial services context where AI failures have real consequences.
Implement testing strategies appropriate for non-deterministic AI systems: unit tests for deterministic components, evaluation suites for LLM behaviour (using frameworks such as LangSmith Evals, RAGAS, or custom evaluation pipelines), regression testing for prompt changes, and integration testing across the full agent workflow.
Participate actively in code review, architecture discussions, and production incident response — with a culture of collective ownership over system reliability and continuous improvement.

Requirements
Experience and background

Strong AI Engineering experience with proven expertise in designing, building, deploying, and operating production-grade AI systems. Candidates should have 5-8 years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on AI/ML engineering and hands-on delivery of LLM-powered products in production.
Hands-on experience with modern agentic AI frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent; strong familiarity with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs and their tool-calling and streaming APIs.
Demonstrated experience shipping production AI systems with real users — not research experiments, but deployed products with monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement cycles.
Experience in financial services, fintech, or data-intensive regulated industries is advantageous.

Technical capabilities

Languages and frameworks: Python (primary, including FastAPI, asyncio, Pydantic), TypeScript/JavaScript (React, Next.js, Node.js); comfortable across the stack without deep specialisation limiting your ability to contribute end-to-end.
AI/ML stack: LLM integration (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini), embedding models, vector databases, RAG pipeline components, evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, RAGAS, custom), and observability tooling (Helicone, LangFuse, or equivalent).
Infrastructure and DevOps: containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, or GCP), CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, and basic security hygiene for AI systems (input sanitisation, output validation, access-scoped tool permissions).
Data engineering basics: SQL proficiency, familiarity with data pipeline tooling (dbt, Airflow, or equivalent), and ability to design data access patterns optimised for AI consumption.

Azure Architektur: Du entwickelst moderne, sichere und skalierbare Azure-Architekturen und erstellst die Architekturplanung für die zu implementierende Lösung.

Integration & APIs: Du kennst die Möglichkeiten von Azure API Management, Service Bus und Event Grid und kannst diese sinnvoll in moderne Lösungsarchitekturen integrieren.
Betrieb & Resilienz: Du berücksichtigst Monitoring, Verfügbarkeit, Backup und Disaster Recovery bereits im Lösungsdesign und nutzt dafür beispielsweise Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Backup und Azure Site Recovery.
Governance & Kosten: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, ihre Azure-Umgebung kontrollierbar und wirtschaftlich zu betreiben und berücksichtigst dabei Governance- und FinOps-Prinzipien.

WIE DIR DAS GELINGT

Architekturkompetenz: Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen analysieren, technische Optionen bewerten und daraus verständliche, sichere und skalierbare Lösungsarchitekturen entwickeln.
Azure Best Practices: Konzepte wie Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Landing Zones und Azure Well-Architected Framework sind dir vertraut.
Infrastructure as Code: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Terraform und/oder Bicep sowie mit Automatisierungs- und Deployment-Prozessen.

DevOps: GitHub, GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps sowie CI/CD-Konzepte sind dir vertraut.

Reisebereitschaft & Flexibilität: Du bist bereit, projektbezogen zu reisen, und arbeitest gern in agilen Teams.

CHANCENGEBER - WAS ADESSO AUSMACHT

new_jobs.description:
Una de las consultoras más reconocidas de integración tecnológica global con la que colaboramos en Joppy busca incorporar alguien Senior ASP.NET Web API Developer
para unirse a un equipo de desarrollo backend, participando en el diseño, construcción y mantenimiento de APIs y servicios que respaldan aplicaciones internas.

🎯 Funciones principales

Colaborar con Product Owner en la definición de requisitos y user stories.
Trabajar junto al equipo Front-End en el diseño de la comunicación entre sistemas.
Diseñar arquitectura y desarrollar APIs REST.
Diseñar arquitectura y desarrollar bases de datos.
Elaborar documentación técnica de las APIs desarrolladas.
Realizar testing y troubleshooting de servicios backend.
Participar en todo el ciclo de vida del software (diseño, desarrollo, despliegue y mantenimiento).
Interactuar con otros departamentos para comprender necesidades de negocio.

🛠️ Requisitos imprescindibles

Formación en Ingeniería Técnica, Matemáticas, Física o titulación STEM equivalente.
Más de 5 años de experiencia con ASP.NET (preferiblemente .NET 6 o superior).
Más de 3 años de experiencia en diseño y desarrollo de APIs REST.
Sólidos conocimientos en principios SOLID, especialmente Dependency Injection.
Más de 3 años de experiencia en testing backend.
Más de 3 años de experiencia con Entity Framework.

➕ Requisitos valorables

Experiencia con arquitecturas de microservicios en cloud.
Experiencia en despliegue de backends (Azure, IIS u otros entornos).
Conocimientos en tecnologías Front-End (HTML, JavaScript, CSS).
Nivel de inglés B2 o superior.
Conocimiento del sector industrial o de máquina herramienta.
Carnet de conducir y vehículo propio (preferible, no obligatorio).

🤗 Condiciones

Contrato indefinido.
Jornada completa.
Modelo híbrido: 2 días de teletrabajo y presencial en Zaldibar.
Horario: lunes a viernes de 08:00 a 13:00 y de 13:30 a 16:30.
Posibilidad de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.
Participación en proyectos tecnológicos internos de alto impacto.
Salario competitivo según experiencia y perfil (40.000 – 60.000 € brutos/año).

new_jobs.title: API Designer / Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Project Details

- Location: Barcelona

- Work mode: Hybrid, 3 days per week onsite

- Start date: ASAP

- Duration: 3-month trial period, then 1-year contract

- Extension possibility: Renewal for 2 additional years

- Language(s): English (mandatory), Spanish (recommended), French (a plus)

Main Responsibilities

- Gather and challenge business requirements and specify APIs with business, IT, architects and backend teams

- Review and validate API designs from other teams against our quality, naming and convention standards

- Create and review Pull Requests on API specifications

- Support development teams to ensure implementations match the specification

- Analyse integration workflow issues and drive resolution with the teams involved

- Take part in the API Design Authority committee and internal API community

Mandatory Experience:

- 5+ years as Business Analyst

- 3+ years in API design (writing API specifications)

- Hands-on work with OpenAPI 3.x and Swagger 2.0

- Solid knowledge of REST, HTTP, response codes and API standards

- Project management skills to deliver on schedule

Preferred Experience:

- Ability to write code or scripts

- At ease with production management and monitoring

- API security standards (OAuth2, JWT, SAML)
